title: Honesty and responsibility
intro: Doing our duties on time, carefully and well.

learn.html: Among the virtues every person – and every Muslim – should have are honesty and responsibility. They complete each other: if someone is honest, they are responsible; if someone is responsible, they are honest.

A person who does their duties on time can be called honest and responsible. We decorate ourselves with these qualities from childhood so we stay like this when we grow up. If we do our maktab and school work on time, we are already building these habits.
Allah created us to make an effort, and our effort will be seen by Him, His Messenger and the believers. So every boy and girl should try to be honest and responsible.

items: doing them completely, as we were asked
leaving the place where we worked tidy
if we can, doing more than we were asked

learn.text: How to do maktab or school homework

items: after a rest, start the homework straight away
do it the way the muallim or teacher said
keep the page clean and tidy
if allowed, make the page look nice
afterwards, put the books back in the bag and tidy the place where you worked

practice.title: Doing homework well
items: Rest a little after coming home
Do it as the teacher said
Keep the page clean and tidy
Put the books away and tidy up

practice.title: Honest and responsible?
practice.prompt: Tap everything an honest, responsible pupil does, then tap Check.

options.text: Does a bit more than asked
Leaves it until the last minute and rushes
options.why: We do our duties on time and carefully.

questions.q: How do honesty and responsibility relate?

options: Allah, His Messenger and the believers
